claim_boundary: Snapshot only. Fixes a specification and a carried-forward panel. Asserts no analysis output, no occupancy, no probability, no numeric security, no breakthrough, and no goal completion. Zero curve/isogeny/circuit compute.
commit_sha_note: null by design; the receipt rides inside its own archive commit and the sha is recorded in the batch dispatch queue.

preregistration.why_the_snapshot_must_precede_the_rerun: The panel and the machine definition must be immutable BEFORE any audit output exists, or the rerun can be post-selected to fit its own result. That durability is what BATCH-015 established as a process success and it is the one property this snapshot exists to carry forward.

record_ids_note: No ledger record is minted by a preregistration snapshot; it fixes artifacts before they are used.

verification.scope: exact declared producer and receipt paths
